architecture.editorial_thesis: In 2026-W37 efficiency became vertical — OpenAI packaged Astra into Financial Services, voice, and harness APIs on Sep 10, DeepSeek shipped a 552B CED flagship that beats its Pro at Flash rates, Cognition pushed coding Pareto (SWE-2) and harness Pareto (Fusion), and open weights went vertical (MiniCPM on-device, North translation, Ling multimodal) — while Anthropic's Sep 10 threat report plus a 100M-reach resignation set the safety bound for the same week.
architecture_goals: Center Astra vertical packaging without overstating benchmarks
Present voice + harness APIs with beta/preview discipline
Ground efficient flagship in arch/pricing/open bounds
Show coding/harness Pareto with partnered-eval bounds
Show open vertical releases with license/date precision
Place threat report with notable-examples bounds and discourse context
